description:
~Sine VFX~

An all-in-one VFX editor and toolkit built for Roblox Studio

Features:
- Asset Library (14k+ Assets) (Textures,Beams,Meshes,Scripts,Sounds,Meshflipbooks)
- emit window can emit and enable any vfx instance
- color picker window
- global Studio API (shared.sv)
- particle counter
- particle path visualizer
- particle spawn shape visualizer
- runtime module to play sine's vfx in game
- a better graph and gradient editor for editing number sequences
- trail preview
- retimer & resizer
- copier to copy properties from 1 emitter and paste them into another
- shifter for shifting properties
- custom properties window with better stuff
- 3d particles - basically mesh vfx / mesh particles that work similarly to particle emitters
- Mesh Flipbooks (3d partcles)
- transformed trails and beams
- transformed highlight & lights
- screen effects (cam shakes, blurs, fov)
- beziers/splines
- craters
- trail lightning
- custom themes & settings
- and more..

Plugin inspired by vfx forge & qp2
